caption: The drawing depicts a man's suit without a head, hands, or feet visible. The suit consists of three main pieces: a short, light-colored (possibly white or cream) jacket with a collar and three buttons on the right side; high-waisted matching trousers with buttons at the waist; and a ruffled shirt underneath, also in a light shade. At the neck, instead of a head, there is a blue patterned cloth with red, green, and white geometric and floral motifs, tied as a bow or cravat. The background is plain, and the suit is rendered mainly in shades of pale gray and white, with the cravat area introducing color through its blue, red, green, and white design. The composition centers the suit upright, occupying most of the vertical space, and there are no additional objects or backgrounds depicted.
title: Man's Suit
